existing_pipeline_constraints: Current preprocessing loads a project-specific 2436 wavelength vector.
Existing feature extraction assumes the current NPZ/ROI schema and labels summaries as reflectance.
required_adapter: Separate source namespace and loader with NPZ key, shape, dtype, finite-value, and checksum validation.
Explicit metadata mapping for source DOI, cube ID, trial, plant, isolate/control, leaf, part, and date.
Per-cube wavelength provenance and calibration-status fields; never default to 2436 wavelengths or reflectance labels.
pipeline_compatibility.classification: Not supported for valid plant-level train/test evaluation by the three public cubes: all three metadata-mapped cubes are from inoculated plants and no public cube maps to a control; isolate 065 has one public plant and isolate 028 has two, all in trial 4.
pipeline_compatibility.exploratory_analysis: Potentially suitable after cube-level wavelength/calibration/shape validation, kept source-separated and interpreted descriptively.
pipeline_compatibility.forecasting: Not supported; dated metadata rows do not provide a sample-linked spectral time series or validated forecast target.
pipeline_compatibility.cross_dataset_pooling: Not scientifically justified as a direct Botrytis alternative; preserve pathogen and experiment identity.

final_decision.scope: Source-separated, exploratory work after cube, wavelength, calibration, and sample metadata validation.
conditions: Verify NPZ internals, shape, dtype, and checksums.
Verify full wavelength vector, band order, calibration procedure, and units per cube.
Resolve README/metadata distance and integration-time conflicts.
Verify plant/isolate/control mapping and sample-level disease evidence.
Obtain sufficient additional independent cube samples before classification or forecasting work.
Keep Alternaria distinct from Botrytis and use plant-grouped evaluation.
prohibited_claims_or_uses: No claim of disease prediction or forecasting.
No claim that cube values are calibrated reflectance.
No biological independence inferred from pixel, row, leaf, or file counts.
No cross-pathogen pooled training without a justified protocol.
